speaker: Ms Poh Li San
text: asked the Acting Minister for Transport in view of the high Certificate of Entitlement (COE) prices, whether the Minister will reconsider implementing COE renewal for shorter durations such as annually or two-yearly, so that existing car owners can have more affordable options to extend their cars ownership beyond 10 years.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: We understand the concerns of existing car owners who wish to renew their Certificates of Entitlement (COEs).

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: However, we need to balance their interest with those who wish to buy a new car.

speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang West)
text: Many of our small businesses, hawkers, for example, they need their vehicles for their businesses, and because of the high quantum of the COE, it is difficult for them to sustain their business because of a very huge, lumpy sum that is needed to pay for the COE.

speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang West)
text: Hence, the suggestion to consider shorter tenures or shorter terms for the COE.

speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang West)
text: Will there be any possibilities to consider only for the commercial vehicles, for example, in this case, to have a shorter term for renewals, just to help these smaller businesses tide through?
